name: Anderson University
tuition_note: Private (independent) school, single published rate. Tuition $32,260 and Room $6,460 (room only) are the most recent figures from Anderson University's official cost-of-attendance PDF (anderson.edu/uploads/soe/cost-attendance.pdf), which lists 2021-2022 as its latest year (Board separately $4,670). Note: NCES College Navigator reports newer 2024-25 figures of $37,240 tuition & fees and $12,800 combined food+housing, but no room-only breakout was available for the current year, so the school's own most-recent room-only figure was used.
